$comment: Lean solo-dev flow: implement → gate command → push → PR → CI loop → auto-merge (no reviews, no human approval on merge). Define your own `gate` commands and roles in the project config.

pipeline.prompt:
Implement: {{feature.title}}. Work in {{feature.worktree}}, commit as you go.
When the implementation is complete, call conductor_report with outcome=succeeded and notes shaped as a PR description in markdown — they become the pull request body verbatim:
## Summary
<what and why, 2-4 sentences>
## Changes
<bulleted list: file/area — what changed>
## Test plan
<how it is verified: tests added/run, commands>
Write it for a human reviewer seeing the PR cold.
